title: 商品画像をアップロードして、Seedance 2.0の生成をプロンプトで制御する
content:
商品画像をアップロードして、Seedance 2.0の生成をプロンプトで制御する  
ロゴや商標が出ないように、LLM（ChatGPT）と壁打ちしながら「ロゴを徹底的に無くす」方向でプロンプトを詰める  
編集なしで完結させたい場合は、GPT Image 2で素材を整えてからSeedance 2.0に渡すワークフローにする

Upload product images and control the generation of Seedance 2.0 with prompts  
To ensure logos and trademarks do not appear, refine the prompt in the direction of "thoroughly removing logos" while brainstorming with LLM (ChatGPT)  
If you want to complete it without editing, prepare the materials with GPT Image 2 before passing them to Seedance 2.0 in your workflow

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
https://t.co/IcJMtDXtOF

--- LINKED ARTICLE: Pollo AI Soccer Support CM Challenge Held! ---
Soccer has the power to move people. ⚽️🎬  
The cheers that shake the stadium, the dynamic players, the moment of victory—  
Now it's your turn to express that energy in advertising.  
From a single fictional product image, create soccer support campaign-style creatives with Pollo AI 🔥  
🏆 Total prize money of 250,000 yen + a chance to be displayed on a Shibuya street vision!

## 🎬 This Theme

"From a single fictional product image to soccer support campaign-style advertising materials"  
Create advertising visuals and videos that capture the energy of soccer, themed around fictional products and brands such as sports drinks, energy bars, support goods, and sportswear that do not exist 🔥  
Submissions can be videos or still images!

## 🏆 Total Prize Money 250,000 yen!

🎬 Video Category
- Grand Prize: 100,000 yen (1 winner)
- Excellence Award: 10,000 yen (5 winners)
🖼 Light Category
- Grand Prize: 50,000 yen (1 winner)
- Excellence Award: 10,000 yen (5 winners)

🎥 Special Feature
The grand prize-winning work will be displayed on a street vision in Shibuya, Tokyo for 7 days ✨  
🎁 Participation Benefits
- First 150 participants: 200 credits
- 20 participants by lottery: 1-month Pro membership (worth 4,700 yen)

## 👩‍💻 Entry Conditions

- Must be a work using Pollo AI
- Video Category: Video work within 10 to 30 seconds
- Light Category: Still image works such as product visuals and support posters
- Include at least one Pollo AI feature used or production process
- Submit the application form

## 👇 Example of Production Process Description

- Features used: Commerce Studio / Marketing Studio / GPT Image 2 / Seedance 2.0, etc.
- Production process: Upload product image and use soccer support-style template
- Prompt ingenuity: Specify stadium lighting, cheers, speed, and support mood
- Editing: Add BGM, captions, color correction  
*It is not necessary to write everything. You can apply by sharing at least one item!

## ⭐️ How to Apply

① Follow @PolloAIJP  
② Repost this post  
③ Post your work with a quoted repost  
④ Include #PolloAIサッカーCM in the post text  
⑤ Briefly describe the Pollo AI feature used or production process  
⑥ Submit your work information via the application form

📝 Application Form: [https://forms.gle/Anw2uuWKTtoDQw5UA]  
*Application is complete with both X post and form submission.

## ⚠️ Notes

Real company names, brand names, product names, logos, trademarks, real players, clubs, national teams, official uniforms, FIFA, World Cup, etc., official materials cannot be used.  
- Create works with fictional products, fictional brands, and original materials.  
- Use copyright-free or commercially usable BGM and materials.  
- The copyright of the submitted works belongs to the applicant, but Pollo AI can use and introduce them for PR purposes.  
- Outdoor vision display is limited to works that pass media screening. If display is difficult, the organizer and the winner will consult and respond.

## 🗓 Application Period:

- June 26, 2026, to July 6, 2026, 23:59  
- Results announcement: Scheduled for July 10, 2026

The frenzy of soccer.  
The unity of support.  
Advertising expressions where products shine.

We look forward to soccer support campaign-style creatives that only AI can create ⚽️🎬

Your work might be displayed on a street vision in Shibuya, Tokyo for 7 days!
